notes: Zone details do not publish a lifecycle state enum, so a successful query is not used as a readiness signal.
Record-detail enabled has no explicit numeric mapping in that operation; the waiters use the list operations whose own schemas explicitly define 1 and 0.
Record validation and metrics are stateless retrievals, not asynchronous lifecycle operations.

request_notes: Record validation and monitoring POSTs are retryable stateless queries; mutations always require confirmation and are not retried.
VPC ID lists are published comma-separated strings, while record values are JSON arrays; their wire types remain distinct.
The old and new record-list examples differ in value shape and pagination placement; each command retains its captured response.
The historical record-detail example has lowercase ttl while the table says TTL. The display uses the captured field and avoids duplicate ttl selector keys.
